commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Mio Backhaus is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
87' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
86' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fabio Silva walks off the pitch to be replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
83' 3 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 3:0.

80' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
78' PENALTY APPEAL after Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
76' 2 - 0 Goal! Felix Nmecha tees up Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.

67' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Julian Ryerson and he is replaced by Daniel Svensson (Dortmund).
67' Substitution. Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) replaces Maximilian Beier.
66' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mio Backhaus scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
65' Dortmund are seeing far more of the ball now.

55' A huge opportunity wasted! Fabio Silva (Dortmund) produces a header from a rebound inside the six-yard box. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Dortmund.
55' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Mio Backhaus makes a save.
54' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
53' A corner kick by Dortmund is thwarted by the well prepared Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen).

26' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Werder Bremen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

18' Great touch by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
17' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

16' Yan Couto (Dortmund) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
15' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) is penalised for holding. Daniel Siebert signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Dortmund in a dangerous position.
14' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.

11' 1 - 0 Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Julian Ryerson. His bullet header went towards the middle of the goal and behind the goalkeeper. It's 1:0.
11' Dortmund win a corner.
11' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
7' Yan Couto (Dortmund) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Siebert no option but to blow his whistle.

5' That's unlucky! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.

4' A neat pass is well received by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
